summary: Master VR and AR in tourism. Learn to design immersive visitor experiences, implement AR wayfinding, and drive ROI with XR technology. Enroll today.
lede: Virtual and augmented reality in tourism training helps tourism, hospitality, and heritage professionals plan immersive visitor experiences. Participants learn to assess hardware and infrastructure, design VR destination previews and AR wayfinding for pre-trip and on-site use, and evaluate user experience, accessibility, privacy, and project return on investment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for digital transformation and visitor experience within the global travel and heritage sectors.
modules: Immersive Technology Landscape in Global Tourism
VR for Destination Marketing and Pre-Trip Engagement
AR for On-Site Visitor Experience and Wayfinding
Digital Twins and Cultural Heritage Preservation
Hospitality Innovation and the Virtual Concierge
Ethics, Privacy, and Accessibility in Immersive Tech
AI and Personalization in Immersive Tourism
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 2 years of experience in tourism marketing, museum management, or digital strategy. Basic familiarity with digital content formats (3D models, 360-degree video) is recommended. No prior coding knowledge is required, though an understanding of mobile app ecosystems is beneficial.
